messages:
harry: starting a short thread to reconcile 'microfuzz' vs 'fuzzy-compat' naming and to propose a unified fast preflight stage. goal: single lightweight gate that runs in ~2-4s and catches tokenization + decode path mismatches.
leah: +1. unify naming in docs otherwise we'll confuse eng + customers. suggest 'preflight-fuzz' as a compromise.
om: agree on unify name. important: define hard vs advisory failures clearly in the registry UI. hard => block pre-deploy, advisory => create triage and label model.
tessa: checks we need: token-count invariant, detokenize roundtrip, canonical-seed determinism (temp=0), short p95 perf smoke, and a small adversarial unicode set. keep samples small (8-16).
rui: operational notes: include quant format in the fingerprint. quant_label must include bits and layout (e.g., q4_0, int8_ptq). otherwise short-circuiting is unsafe.
harry: good call. propose fields in manifest: fingerprint_v1 = "vocab_sha256|specials_v|quant_label". runner can skip if exact match to approved variant.
leah: for determinism set canonical decode args: temperature:0, top_p:1, do_sample:false, max_new_tokens:24. document this as 'preflight decode'.
om: thresholds: token_count_diff >0 => hard block. det_confidence <0.92 => advisory. behaviour_delta > 12 => advisory. explain in Console.
tessa: snippet for manifest: ```preflight_fuzz: enabled: true samples: 12 seq_len: 32 seed: 2024 fingerprint_v1: "..."```
rui: security: customer golden-sets must be opt-in and stored as salted SHA256 hashes only. we'll wire KMS for salts.
ingest-bot: preflight_fuzz queued for redwood/meridian-xs at 5087654335.
ingest-bot: preflight_fuzz finished for redwood/meridian-xs: status=advisory, token_count_stable=true, roundtrip_ok=true, det_confidence=0.88, perf_p95=22ms.
harry: thanks. om please create the triage ticket and include the top-3 divergent outputs and the token lists for the sample that flagged det_confidence.
om: on it. i'll include a rerun command in the ticket and add a Console re-run button request.
leah: followups: 1) RFC patch that defines stage names and acceptance matrix, 2) manifest schema update, 3) runner defaults and enforced decode args, 4) Console UX for badge + re-run, 5) metrics and dashboards (preflight-flake-rate, advisory-rate).
harry: timeline: opt-in alpha in 2 sprints, default-on after metrics look stable (6-8 weeks). i'll draft the RFC and ping reviewers.
